entries.title: Psalms 11:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> In Jehovah do I take refuge: How say ye to my soul, Flee [as] a bird to your mountain;

entries.title: Psalms 11:2
segments: For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, They make ready their arrow upon the string, That they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart;

entries.title: Psalms 11:3
segments: If the foundations be destroyed, What can the righteous do?

entries.title: Psalms 11:4
segments: Jehovah is in his holy temple; Jehovah, his throne is in heaven; His eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 11:5
segments: Jehovah trieth the righteous; But the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

entries.title: Psalms 11:6
segments: Upon the wicked he will rain snares; Fire and brimstone and burning wind shall be the portion of their cup.

entries.title: Psalms 11:7
segments: For Jehovah is righteous; he loveth righteousness: The upright shall behold his face.
